selection.edition: international Formbricks Cloud Management API v2
selection.ownership: Formbricks GmbH, Kiel, Germany. Reviewed edition is Formbricks Cloud at app.formbricks.com/api/v2, not a caller-supplied self-hosted host.

research.searchCoverage: Official Formbricks API v2 OpenAPI lists server https://app.formbricks.com/api/v2 as Formbricks Cloud. Self-hosting exists but is a separate edition. Auth is x-api-key. Formbricks GmbH is EU-based (Kiel, Germany) with cloud hosting in Germany. Dated incident search found CVE-2025-59934 (JWT signature verification, patched in 4.0.1, 2025-09) as a historical vulnerability, not an unresolved Formbricks Cloud compromise. This is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Formbricks Cloud Management API v2
research.searchCoverage: Formbricks Cloud is a managed edition at app.formbricks.com; self-hosting is optional. Pinned source hardcodes that cloud host. CVE-2025-59934 was patched in 4.0.1.

incidents.finding: CVE-2025-59934 missing JWT signature verification in versions before 4.0.1. Patched in 4.0.1. Historical OSS vulnerability, not an unresolved Formbricks Cloud customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: Historical non-China incident coverage is permitted by the dated user waiver.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /me on Formbricks Cloud. Native omits the upstream user-agent. Self-hosted caller hosts are not supported.
Returns raw GET /me JSON under data instead of the upstream normalized {organizationId, organizationAccess, workspaces, environments} object.
Optional limit (1–250), skip, sortBy, order, and workspaceId bind to documented query names. Date filters and deprecated environmentId are omitted. Returns raw {data, meta} JSON under data.
contactAttributeKeyId is URL-encoded as a path segment. Returns raw key JSON under data rather than the upstream {contactAttributeKey} wrapper. Writes are omitted.
Official POST /management/contact-attribute-keys. Native omits deprecated environmentId.
Official GET /management/surveys with documented pagination.
Official GET /management/surveys/{surveyId}.
Official POST /management/surveys. Question blocks are omitted from this bounded create.
Official PUT /management/surveys/{surveyId} for name and status.
Official DELETE /management/surveys/{surveyId}. Empty 204 maps to deleted+surveyId.
Official GET /management/responses with optional surveyId filter.
Official GET /management/responses/{responseId}.
Official POST /management/responses.
Official PUT /management/responses/{responseId}.
Official DELETE /management/responses/{responseId}. Empty 204 maps to deleted+responseId.
Official GET /management/contacts.
Official GET /management/contacts/{contactId}.
Official POST /management/contacts with attributes object.
Official GET /management/webhooks.
Official GET /management/webhooks/{webhookId}.
Official POST /management/webhooks. Native omits deprecated environmentId.
EventOnly inbound webhook. Formbricks POSTs responseCreated payloads to a registered URL.
EventOnly inbound webhook. Formbricks POSTs responseUpdated payloads to a registered URL.
EventOnly inbound webhook. Formbricks POSTs responseFinished payloads to a registered URL.
